verdict.rationale: GrowthBook ships an official MCP server that lets AI tools like Cursor, VS Code, and Claude operate GrowthBook in natural language. It loads first-party Agent Skills (workflows and guardrails) and makes authenticated REST API calls, with a confirmation gate that holds risky changes for a person to approve. Natural-language operation therefore depends on an external AI client. Missing for 10: a native in-app natural-language assistant (the Cmd+K palette is navigation only, and the 'AI Visual Editor' is not documented as accepting natural-language commands), detail on which operations the Agent Skills cover, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
